skill.summary: A secure, human-approved autonomous agent architecture that combines SMFOI-KERNEL orientation with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL), Proposal-First decision-making,...

latestVersion.changelog:
SafeProactive v1.1.2

- All documentation revised and translated from English to Italian.
- Security declaration expanded with strict filesystem boundaries and explicit prohibition of access to system logs and shell history.
- Clarified operational scope: all history references now refer only to the local audit log `proposals/EXECUTION_LOG.md`.
- Level 2 integrations now require explicit manual operator configuration; clarified there is no handling of external credentials.
- Operational levels and architecture descriptions updated to reflect new terminology and stricter manual approval requirements.
